description: Combine the remotely accepted integrated candidate with the selected n1024 two-CTA 768-thread width-16 clustered reducer and two-stage strict unsafe-tail correction: retain the extension-owned mapped classifier, intact hard-batch fallback, consolidated certificates, n512 row-warp path and n2048 direct panels; reconcile reducer templates and obsolete code, then profile all six custom sizes and tune measured integration overhead.

Integrated the selected n1024 two-CTA 768-thread width-16 reducer into the remotely accepted six-size candidate by reusing its functionally equivalent generic clustered panel template, running all 64 panels and rank-32 ATen trailing updates inside C++, and removing the obsolete packed-prefix/tail path. All 39 validations pass. Full geomean improves from parent 32451.361 to 31922.260 us; dense n1024 is 62939.296 us, while mixed/nearrank/geometric classifier fallbacks remain 106224/105760/102647 us. The selected branch measured dense n1024 57034 us, leaving its second strict unsafe-tail correction and integration overhead to add next.

Added the selected two-stage strict-FP32 unsafe-tail correction inside the extension with a scoped matmul-precision guard, exact recertification after each compacted correction, and the intact 75% whole-batch hard fallback. All 39 validations pass. Full geomean improves 31922.260->31517.277 us and dense n1024 falls 62939.296->52537.355 us; mixed/nearrank/geometric remain whole-batch library routes at 105995/105643/102756 us. The scoped guard restores the caller precision on every return.

Reduced the integrated two-CTA n1024 panel width from 16 to 12, trading shorter panel dependency chains for 86 clustered launches and rank-24 trailing updates. All 39 validations pass. Dense n1024 measures 52979.624 us versus 52537.355 for width 16, and full geomean is 31565.678 us versus 31517.277; the narrower point is slower on the targeted shape.

Restored width-16 panels and specialized the shared clustered reducer to four-lane A*v row-dot groups only for n1024, doubling concurrent row groups without changing n352/n2048 instantiations. All 39 validations pass, but dense n1024 regresses 52537.355->61233.429 us and full geomean to 31885.316 us; doubled per-lane inner work dominates the extra groups.

Restored the selected eight-lane row dots and raised the n1024 panel cluster from two to three 768-thread CTAs. All 39 validations pass, but the 60-matrix batch expands from 120 to 180 blocks and crosses the B200's 148-SM one-wave floor: dense n1024 regresses 52537.355->65492.063 us and full geomean to 32043.437 us.

Restored the selected two-CTA/eight-lane geometry and narrowed n1024 panels to width 8, doubling panel launches and using rank-16 trailing updates. All 39 validations pass. Dense n1024 measures 55278.422 us versus 52537.355 for width 16; full geomean is 31628.572 us. Width 16 remains the measured integration point.

Restored the selected two-CTA, 768-thread, width-16, eight-lane n1024 panel geometry after the structured width/CTA/dot sweep. Final validation passes 39/39. Full geomean is 31499.025 us, reproducing the prior best 31517.277 within noise; dense n1024 is 52601.568 us, mixed 106042.348, nearrank 105768.608, and geometric 102762.510 us. Every smaller custom route and n2048 remains intact.

Selected clean commit f761f9301b93a9cafe8ede119799c1d9a850d4ce: 31499.025 us geomean, 39/39 validation, dense n1024 52601.568 us, and intact mapped classifier/hard-batch fallback (mixed 106042.348, nearrank 105768.608, geometric 102762.510 us). This combines the accepted six-size parent with the two-CTA 768-thread width-16 clustered n1024 reducer by reusing the consolidated generic reducer template, moving the 64-panel loop and reusable triplet workspace into C++, deleting the obsolete packed prefix/tail route, and adding two exact-recertified strict-FP32 unsafe-tail corrections under a scoped precision guard. Trial measurements: reducer-only integration 31922.260/dense 62939.296 us; strict two-stage correction 31517.277/52537.355; width12 31565.678/52979.624; four-lane dots 31885.316/61233.429; three CTAs 32043.437/65492.063; width8 31628.572/55278.422; selected replay 31499.025/52601.568. Final nsys captures exist for all six custom sizes at this SHA: n32 fused Householder 2.985 ms; n176 reducer/solve 23.395/19.711 ms; n352 panels 42.494 ms; n512 accurate panels 25.184 ms; n1024 panels/solve/reorth 29.823/11.306/2.448 ms with no cuSOLVER repair; n2048 panels 183.560 ms. Keep this line moving: n1024 still exposes TMA or double-buffered row staging inside the 29.823 ms reducer, and an exact-order warp-specialized A*v service; the 11.306 ms fused tridiagonal solve/backtransform is the next independent structural target. The current C++ loop already removes Python dispatch and allocator boundaries, so future integration work can focus on those device phases.
